scripts.ci:all: pnpm run ci:lint && pnpm run ci:typecheck && pnpm run ci:test
scripts.guard:eslint: node -e "const v=require('eslint/package.json').version; if(!v.startsWith('8.')){console.error('ESLint must be v8.x, got '+v); process.exit(1)}"
scripts.verify: pnpm run guard:eslint && pnpm run ci:all && pnpm run test:artifact-registry && pnpm run test:brandgraph && pnpm run test:agent-lifecycle
scripts.verify:full: pnpm run verify && pnpm run schemas:check && pnpm run prisma:generate:all
scripts.schemas:check: tsx scripts/generate-json-schemas.ts --check && git diff --exit-code -- packages/brand-trinity-schemas/schemas packages/eval-gates-schemas/schemas packages/brand-events-contracts/schemas
